# `kaolin/ops/mesh/MeshOps.js`

> **Source:** `engine/kaolin/ops/mesh/MeshOps.js`

MeshOps.js — Core Mesh Operations for Kaolin-style 3D Geometry Toolkit Provides half-edge data structure, adjacency queries, normals, area, Laplacian smoothing, validation, and mesh analysis. All operations work on flat typed arrays (GPU-friendly) with optional object wrappers. Data format (Kaolin convention): positions: Float32Array — stride 3 (x, y, z per vertex) indices:   Uint32Array  — stride 3 (v0, v1, v2 per triangle) Compatible with existing engine systems: - MeshDecimation.js (Vertex/Triangle classes) - MeshCutter.js (plain [x,y,z] arrays) - GPUSoftBody.js (SoA GPU buffers) - EntityMeshRenderer (interleaved vertex buffers)

## Classes

### `class HalfEdgeMesh`

Index-based half-edge mesh representation. Each half-edge stores: vertex   — index of the vertex it points TO face     — index of the face it belongs to (-1 for boundary) twin     — index of the opposite half-edge (-1 if boundary) next     — index of the next half-edge in the face loop prev     — index of the previous half-edge in the face loop Stored as parallel typed arrays for cache efficiency.

| Method | Signature | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `constructor` | `constructor(positions, indices)` |  |
| `_build` | `_build()` | Build the half-edge connectivity from triangle soup. |
| `heFrom` | `heFrom(he)` | Get the source vertex of a half-edge. |
| `heTo` | `heTo(he)` | Get the target vertex of a half-edge. |
| `isBoundary` | `isBoundary(he)` | Is this half-edge on the boundary (no twin)? |
| `isClosed` | `isClosed()` | Is this mesh closed (no boundary edges)? |
| `vertexOutgoing` | `vertexOutgoing(v)` | Iterate all half-edges leaving a vertex (one-ring traversal). |
| `vertexNeighbors` | `vertexNeighbors(v)` | Get all vertex indices adjacent to vertex v (one-ring neighbors). |
| `vertexFaces` | `vertexFaces(v)` | Get all face indices adjacent to vertex v. |
| `faceNeighbors` | `faceNeighbors(f)` | Get face indices sharing an edge with face f. |
| `boundaryHalfEdges` | `boundaryHalfEdges()` | Get all boundary half-edge indices (those with no twin). |
| `boundaryLoops` | `boundaryLoops()` | Get ordered boundary loops (arrays of vertex indices). |
| `eulerCharacteristic` | `eulerCharacteristic()` | Euler characteristic: V - E + F For a closed genus-0 mesh, this should be 2. |
| `vertexValences` | `vertexValences()` | Get the valence (degree) of each vertex. |

### `computeFaceNormals(positions, indices, normalize = true)`

Compute per-face normals (unnormalized = area-weighted, or normalized).

**Parameters:**

- `positions` *(Float32Array)* — — stride 3

**Returns:** — stride 3, length = numFaces * 3

### `computeVertexNormals(positions, indices)`

Compute per-vertex normals via area-weighted average of adjacent face normals.

**Parameters:**

- `positions` *(Float32Array)* — — stride 3

**Returns:** — stride 3, length = numVerts * 3

### `computeVertexNormalsAngleWeighted(positions, indices)`

Compute per-vertex normals weighted by the angle at each vertex in each face. More accurate than area-weighted for meshes with very different triangle sizes.

**Parameters:**

- `positions` *(Float32Array)* — — stride 3
- `indices` *(Uint32Array)* — — stride 3

**Returns:** — stride 3, length = numVerts * 3

### `laplacianSmooth(positions, indices, iterations = 1, lambda = 0.5, pinned = null)`

Uniform Laplacian smoothing (iterative). Moves each vertex toward the centroid of its neighbors.

**Parameters:**

- `positions` *(Float32Array)* — — stride 3 (modified in place)
- `indices` *(Uint32Array)* — — stride 3
- `iterations` *(number)* — — number of smoothing passes (default 1)
- `lambda` *(number)* — — step size 0..1 (default 0.5)
- `pinned` *(Set|null)* — — set of vertex indices to keep fixed

**Returns:** — the modified positions array

### `taubinSmooth(positions, indices, iterations = 5, lambda = 0.5, mu = -0.53, pinned = null)`

Taubin smoothing (λ|μ) — Laplacian smooth that preserves volume. Alternates positive (shrinking) and negative (inflating) steps.

**Parameters:**

- `positions` *(Float32Array)* — — stride 3 (modified in place)
- `indices` *(Uint32Array)* — — stride 3
- `iterations` *(number)* — — number of λ|μ pairs (default 5)
- `lambda` *(number)* — — shrink factor (default 0.5)
- `mu` *(number)* — — inflate factor (default -0.53, must be < -lambda)
- `pinned` *(Set|null)* — — set of vertex indices to keep fixed

### `cotangentLaplacianSmooth(positions, indices, lambda = 0.5, pinned = null)`

Cotangent-weighted Laplacian smoothing (1 iteration). More geometrically accurate than uniform — preserves curvature better.

**Parameters:**

- `positions` *(Float32Array)* — — stride 3 (modified in place)
- `indices` *(Uint32Array)* — — stride 3
- `lambda` *(number)* — — step size (default 0.5)
- `pinned` *(Set|null)* — — pinned vertices
